lineage: New synthetic differential checks. No H14/H15/H9/A1 or BE observations, fits, thresholds, or economic trials reused.
data: Only synthetic odds, fixed goal parameters, point-mass score grids and symbolic cash orders defined in this file. No real matches.
resources: Python 3.13 isolated venv; numpy 2.2.6 scipy 1.15.3. One deterministic run, no fitting/tuning, CPU, 120-second subprocess timeout. Only reviewed source modules loaded; no network during benchmark.

experiments.question: Does a normalized 0..12 NB+DC grid hide material truncation?
experiments.baseline: Current model._score_grid; analytical NB CDF product and four-cell DC mass correction; expanded grid 0..100
experiments.metric: lost raw probability mass relative to full corrected mass; maximum absolute 1X2 change
experiments.threshold: diagnostic triggers if omitted mass > 1e-6; this is engineering tolerance, not a learned football threshold
experiments.success: Exact mass identity within 1e-10 and truncation explicitly quantified; negative diagnosis is useful
experiments.decision: If material, recommend tail diagnostics/adaptive support; do not change runtime or declare realized forecast error
